desc: Calendar of event for AGM-2026 of  the company to be held on 25.09.2026

In terms of Regulation 30 of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 (Listing Regulations) we wish to inform that Mrs. Shilpa Dinesh Poddar (DIN: 00164141), and Mr. Prabhat Dinesh Poddar (DIN: 09637477), Non-Executive Directors of the Company, have resigned from the services of the Company w.e.f September 01, 2026 due to the reasons stated in their respective Resignation Letters. The Resignation Letters received from Mrs. Shilpa Dinesh Poddar and Mr. Prabhat Dinesh Poddar, are enclosed herewith.

This is to inform the Exchange that pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015, the Meeting of the Board of Directors of the Company was held on Saturday, August 29, 2026 at 10:30 A.M. at the Corporate office of the Company at 306, Tantia Jogani Industrial Estate, J. R. Boricha Marg, Lower Parel, Mumbai - 400011 wherein the following decisions were taken:
1. Convening of the 44th Annual General Meeting of the Company through Video Conferencing on Tuesday, September 29, 2026 for the Financial Year ended March 31, 2026.
2. Register of Members and Share Transfer Books of the Company shall be closed from September 23, 2026 to September 29, 2026 (both days inclusive) and the cutoff date for determining the eligibility of shareholders for e-voting has been fixed as September 22, 2026 for the purpose of AGM of the Company.
3. Approval of Board''s Report for the Financial Year 2025-26.
The Board Meeting commenced at 10:30 A.M. and concluded at 11:30 A.M.

This is to inform the Exchange that 44th Annual General Meeting of the Company will be held through Video Conferencing/Other Audio-Visual Means on Tuesday, September 29, 2026 for the FInancial year ended on March 31, 2026.

This is to inform the Exchange that Register of Members and Share Transfer Books of the Company shall be closed from September 23, 2026 to September 29, 2026 (Both days inclusive) for the purpose of 44th Annual General Meeting of the Company.
Submission of summary of proceedings of the 40th Annual General Meeting of the Company held on September 8, 2026 at 11.30 a.m.
